en: Archie
Hold it right there.
Fufufu... So it was you all along.
Look! Look how beautiful it is! The sleeping form of the ancient Pokémon Kyogre!
I have waited so long for this day...
You surprise me, chasing me all the way down here. But it ends now.
For my dream to come true, you have to disappear!
Archie
Fufufu... I'll give you that. You really are gifted.
But! I have this! With the Red Orb, I can make Kyogre...
The Red Orb began to shine all by itself!
Archie
What?! I didn't do anything! Why did the Red Orb... Where has Kyogre gone?
Hm? A message from our people outside...
Yes, what is it? It's raining hard? Good, that's just what should happen. It's why we woke Kyogre, to make the sea grow!
What?! Much harder than we planned? You're in danger?
That can't be... That's impossible... Stay where you are and keep watching!
Something's wrong... The Red Orb was meant to wake Kyogre and let me command it...
So why? Why did Kyogre vanish? Why?!
Maxie
What have you done, Archie? You've woken Kyogre, haven't you?
What becomes of the world if this rain never ends? All the land on earth will sink under a rising sea...
Archie
Wh-what?! Don't you look down on me! Wasn't it Team Magma who woke Groudon and let it go wild?
As long as I have the Red Orb, I can control Kyogre... I should be able to control it...
Maxie
There's no time to argue! Go outside and see it for yourself!
See whether what you've made is the world either of us wanted!
{player}, you have to get out of here too! Come on!
Kyogre is sleeping in the pool. It doesn't stir at all.
